outcome: feasibility of EWS use in LMICs
cohort: 294 live born infants born at <37 weeks and/or <2500 g at a national referral hospital in Nairobi, Kenya, in the first week of life.
finding: Recording of vital signs was variable, and while stakeholders liked the simplicity of the EWS chart, challenges such as staffing levels and printing in color were recognized.
